assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has a known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The clinical indication note supports the above clinical history
Cardiac event monitoring is performed with CPT 93271
Cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias
The arrhythmias may be contributing to the embolic events
The medical necessity is stated in the indication
The service directly addresses the documented cerebral infarction
The service directly addresses the recurrent transient neurological deficits
The cerebral infarction is associated with diagnosis code G45.9
The recurrent transient neurological deficits are associated with diagnosis code I34.0
The PR-204 denial claimed the service is not covered
The appeal is intended to refute the PR-204 denial
